Snel Chiropractic located in Curacao specializes in the treatment of spinal disfuction without the use of drugs or surgery. 
Examples: Whiplash, Lower back pain, Headaches, scolioses, spondylolisthesis, spondylosis, ect. If you need any additional information about any of these symptoms please feel free to contact us.

CBP® Technique emphasizes optimal posture and spinal alignment as the primary goals of chiropractic care while simultaneously documenting improvements in pain and functional based outcomes. The uniqueness of CBP® treatment is in structural rehabilitation of the spine and posture.
